name: The US Government UFO Files (war.gov/ufo), analyzed
description: Every record the US Department of War released on war.gov/ufo: documents, photographs, videos and audio about unidentified anomalous phenomena (UAP), with the agency, incident date and place, release date, page count, redaction status, the official source link, an archived copy, and a plain-English summary and story page from Aliens magazine for each record. Updated whenever a new release appears.
attribution: Data: ALIENS magazine (aliens.co.il), CC BY 4.0. Records: US Department of War, war.gov/ufo.

records.title: 65 HS1-834228961 62-HQ-83894 Section 010
records.summary_en: Florence Dow suspected a flying saucer magazine had communist ties. She contacted the head of the FBI, who stated that the agency does not make such determinations.

records.title: 65 HS1-834228961 62-HQ-83894 Section 002
records.summary_en: A couple saw a burning white ball in a Michigan field, and the fire immediately extinguished. Lane collected melted sand, but tests and conflicting accounts failed to explain what they witnessed.

records.title: 65 HS1-834228961 62-HQ-83894 Section 003
records.summary_en: Gold prospector F.M. Johnson reported seeing a line of silent objects over Mount Adams. He described a dark shape moving at their edge, then the objects tilted on their side and vanished into a cloud.

records.title: 65 HS1-834228961 62-HQ-83894 Section 004
records.summary_en: Two pilots near Bethel, Alaska, swerved sharply to avoid a dark object. One tried to catch it, but the object pulled away, and air traffic control had no record of another aircraft in the area.

records.title: 65 HS1-834228961 62-HQ-83894 Section 005
records.summary_en: Peter Camerlon Jones reported seeing a silver, top-shaped object in the mountains that rose and knocked him down. The FBI searched for him but couldn't find him.

records.title: 65 HS1-834228961 62-HQ-83894 Section 006
records.summary_en: Four Philadelphia police officers witnessed a glowing object land in a field on the evening of September 26, 1950. When they attempted to pick it up, it broke and disintegrated. A small amount of material remained, but the record doesn't state if it was examined.

records.title: 65 HS1-834228961 62-HQ-83894 Section 007
records.summary_en: Two employees observed a blue light with orange edges over a nuclear plant near the Savannah River. The following day, the plant's security official reported it to the FBI, but the message cuts off while describing the light's speed.

records.title: 65 HS1-834228961 62-HQ-83894 Section 009
records.summary_en: Two men in Cuba reported seeing a hat-shaped object hovering silently, then disappearing toward the sea. An FBI representative forwarded the report in case the Bureau was still interested in receiving such accounts.

records.title: 65 HS1-834228961 62-HQ-83894 Serial 130
records.summary_en: The navigator saw an orange object near the plane, and the pilot only noticed it after turning. A cloud obscured it before the crew could identify what they saw.

records.title: 65 HS1-834228961 62-HQ-83894 Serial 164
records.summary_en: In 1949, the US Air Force set guidelines for investigating UFO reports: ascertain how they vanished, search for debris, compare soil samples, and inspect nearby aircraft.

records.title: 65 HS1-834228961 62-HQ-83894 Serial 220
records.summary_en: A Veracruz inventor proposed a nuclear-powered aircraft to a U.S. committee, claiming it could move faster than light and prevent an atomic explosion.

records.title: 65 HS1-834228961 62-HQ-83894 Serial 403
records.summary_en: Gray Barker claimed that flying saucer investigators stopped publishing and speaking after visits from three men in dark suits. The text on the back of his book hints that the investigators discovered something, but doesn't specify what.

records.title: 65 HS1-834228961 62-HQ-83894 Serial 438
records.summary_en: A police officer pursuing a car saw a flame, a silver craft, and two white figures. When he exited his patrol car, he heard thumps and a roar, but the account of the incident cuts off before revealing what happened next.

records.title: 65 HS1-834228961 62-HQ-83894 Serial 449
records.summary_en: A subscriber to a flying saucers magazine thought an article about a message from a distant planet expressed a communist viewpoint. The FBI forwarded the magazine to Los Angeles but did not investigate the organization.

records.title: 65 HS1-834228961 62-HQ-83894 SUB A
records.summary_en: Schmidt said he encountered six people aboard a transparent craft in a field and climbed inside. The craft vanished, and only then could he start his car. Investigators questioned his story after finding oil that resembled commercial motor oil.

records.title: 18 100754 General 1946-7 Vol 2
records.summary_en: In 1947, the US Air Force determined that reports described a real phenomenon. Eyewitnesses described objects that appeared to evade aircraft, but the military didn't know what they were.

records.title: 18 6369445 General 1948 Vol 1
records.summary_en: Witnesses in Hobson, Ohio, reported seeing a round, glowing object at night, moving fast and leaving a trail behind it. The Air Force received the report but did not investigate.

records.title: 255 413270 UFO's and Defense What Should we Prepare For
records.summary_en: Former pilots described encounters with things they couldn’t identify. A French group reviewed the accounts and warned that the reports raised practical challenges for pilots.

records.title: NASA-UAP-D003, Gemini 7 Transcript, 1965
records.summary_en: Borman reported an unidentified object and hundreds of particles. Lovell described a bright object, which the transcript identified as the spacecraft’s booster.

records.title: NASA-UAP-D003A, Gemini 7 Audio Excerpt, 1965
records.summary_en: During the Gemini 7 flight, Frank Borman told NASA he had seen an unidentified object and called it a “bogey.” Jim Lovell can also be heard in the recording.

records.title: 331 120752 Numeric Files 1944–1945 37153 German Armament Equipment Documents
records.summary_en: A 1945 military file from Germany mentions flashing lights, unidentified cylindrical objects, and sightings by an American night-fighter squadron.

records.title: 341 110448 Records Relating to the Collection and Dissemination of Intelligence 1948-1955-TS CONT No.2 2-5300-2-5399
records.summary_en: A summary of a November 1948 Air Force intelligence report mentions flying saucers and unidentified objects in the Netherlands, but describes no sighting.

records.title: 341 110677 Numerical File, 5-2500
records.summary_en: A 1955 report recounts an eyewitness account of an unusual aircraft taking off and flying over Azerbaijan. It doesn’t explain what made the aircraft unusual.

records.title: 342 HS1-416511228 319.1 Flying Discs 1949
records.summary_en: A military file compiled reports from military personnel and civilian aviation workers. They described the objects’ appearance and movements, but the summary does not recount any specific case.

records.title: 38 143685 box Incident Summaries 101-172
records.summary_en: A bomber crew saw a multicolored fireball streak across the sky, leaving smoke behind. The distance kept the crew from determining its size.

records.title: 38 143685 box Incident Summaries 173-233
records.summary_en: A man crossing the Golden Gate Bridge said a light illuminated the ocean. The next day, he noticed a bruise where he had felt as if something had touched him.

records.title: 38 143685 box7 Incident Summaries 1-100
records.summary_en: The document compiles incident summaries, each with an attached checklist of details. Many also include witnesses or additional descriptions, but their content is not in the summary.

records.title: 59 214434 SP 16 [7.18.1963]
records.summary_en: In a 1963 memo, Maxwell Hunter suggested quickly determining the capabilities of visitors from space. In the event of an encounter, he believed humans should set aside their differences.

records.title: 65 HS1-101634279 100-DE-18221 Serial 844
records.summary_en: A Detroit man reported a round object with a dome that appeared to be made of crystal. The FBI documented the report and recommended forwarding it to the Air Force.

records.title: 65 HS1-101634279 100-DE-26505
records.summary_en: In 1944, Wladyslaw Karsosky reported seeing a round craft rise over a wall in Germany. Every time it made a sound, the tractor engine died.

records.title: 65 HS1-834228961 62-HQ-83894 Section 001
records.summary_en: A Wisconsin pastor reported finding a hot metal disc in his yard, with a hole, wires, and small parts in its center. He notified the FBI, but it's unknown if the disc was examined or identified.

records.title: 65 HS1-834228961 62-HQ-83894 Section 008
records.summary_en: For more than 20 years, the FBI collected reports, accounts, and photos of unidentified flying objects in a single file. A new version includes pages that had not been disclosed before, but the released material does not explain what witnesses saw.

records.title: DOW-UAP-D010, Mission Report, Middle East, May 2022
records.summary_en: During a mission in Iraq, an aircraft camera recorded five dots crossing the screen for over four hours. One appeared to the observer as a possible missile, while the other four resembled birds.

records.title: DOW-UAP-D012, Mission Report, Iraq, May 2022
records.summary_en: During a military flight in Iraq, an observer spotted an object moving north and northeast. He attempted to track it but couldn't identify it.

records.title: DOW-UAP-D014, Mission Report, Iraq, May 2022
records.summary_en: A military mission report describes a crew member tracking an object flying north in Syrian airspace. He couldn't identify it, and the object's description was redacted.

records.title: DOW-UAP-D016, Mission Report, Syria, July 2022
records.summary_en: An American crew member reported a phenomenon moving from north to south during a mission over Syria. The event lasted less than a minute, but the report does not describe what was seen.

records.title: DOW-UAP-D018, Mission Report, Iraq, December 2022
records.summary_en: A US service member saw an object moving from west to east in the Baghdad area. He did not pursue it, and the report lists a drone as a possibility without explaining why.

records.title: DOW-UAP-D019, Mission Report, Syria, February 21, 2023
records.summary_en: A two-fighter-jet crew reported three possible objects over Syria. Radar didn't detect them, but two appeared prominent on an infrared sensor. About an hour later, a possible balloon was reported.

records.title: DOW-UAP-D023, Mission Report, United Arab Emirates, October 2023
records.summary_en: During the same mission, two reports of unidentified objects were recorded, 41 minutes apart. The first appeared cold on a thermal camera; their speeds were estimated at approximately 515 and 710 km/h, but the report doesn't explain what they were.

records.title: DOW-UAP-D025, Mission Report, Greece, January 2024
records.summary_en: A US Air Force operator reported a diamond-shaped object seen only on a thermal camera. It disappeared after about two minutes.

records.title: DOW-UAP-D027, Mission Report, United Arab Emirates, October 2023
records.summary_en: A military aircraft crew member saw a glowing sphere with a rod beneath it over the Gulf of Oman. The object moved above the water, and the crew did not attempt to approach.

records.title: DOW-UAP-D028, Mission Report, Iraq, September 2024
records.summary_en: After a missile launch in Iraq, two crew members saw a hot flash streak across the aircraft's sensors. They didn't see the object again, and the report doesn't explain what caused the flash.

records.title: DOW-UAP-D003, Mission Report, Arabian Gulf, 2020
records.summary_en: A US pilot reported four dots that appeared one after another. Clouds interfered with his ability to track and clearly see them.

records.title: DOW-UAP-D032, Mission Report, Syria, October 2024
records.summary_en: On October 20, 2024, during a mission over Syria, light flashes and halos appeared on an aircraft's camera screen for 45 minutes. A light streaked across the image three times, but the crew could not identify its source.

records.title: DOW-UAP-D033, Mission Report, Greece, October 2023
records.summary_en: A military crew member observed a small object over the Aegean Sea. He described sharp turns at an estimated speed of about 130 km/h, then lost it from the video feed.

records.title: DOW-UAP-D035, Mission Report, Greece, October 2023
records.summary_en: A military aircraft crew spotted a small, round object flying over the Aegean Sea toward land. It vanished from the footage, and the report doesn't identify it.

records.title: DOW-UAP-D038, Range Fouler Debrief, Middle East, May 2020
records.summary_en: A military crew again found a white object that had been lost over the water, but lost it once more after zooming in.

records.title: DOW-UAP-D004, Mission Report, Arabian Gulf, 2020
records.summary_en: A military operator reported a phenomenon moving at an estimated 600 km/h, then accelerating and turning east. The report does not identify it.

records.title: DOW-UAP-D042, Range Fouler Debrief, Japan, 2023
records.summary_en: A military crew member reported that a second object, similar to the first but faster, passed it. Later, three objects were seen moving together on the screen, but their identity remains unknown.

records.title: DOW-UAP-D044, Range Fouler Reporting Form, Gulf of Aden, October 2020
records.summary_en: A military operator identified a round, white object on a sensor above the Gulf of Aden. It changed direction several times within about a minute, but the report doesn't explain what it was or how its cold temperature was determined.

records.title: DOW-UAP-D048, Department of the Air Force Report, 1996
records.summary_en: Researchers used launch records and simulated malfunctions to estimate where a missile might impact after a failure. They adjusted two values in their calculations based on the simulated impacts.

records.title: DOW-UAP-D049, Launch Summary, Vandenberg AFB, 2000
records.summary_en: A document summarizes the historical record of launches at Vandenberg Air Force Base from 1958 to 2000. The summary does not describe any particular launch.

records.title: DOW-UAP-D005, Mission Report, Arabian Gulf, 2020
records.summary_en: A US military operator reported two objects that accelerated and turned south. Their speed was estimated at approximately 500 km/h.

records.title: DOW-UAP-D050, Email Correspondence, INDOPACOM, April 2025
records.summary_en: Two American aircraft reported an unidentified phenomenon 14 minutes apart. The sightings lasted 12 and 23 seconds, with no details on altitude or speed.

records.title: DOW-UAP-D051, Email Correspondence, Pacific Time Zone, March 2023
records.summary_en: A civilian reported seeing a glowing blue triangle near a security facility. After hovering in place, it appeared to move in jumps, but its identity remains unknown.

records.title: DOW-UAP-D052, Email Correspondence, NA, August 2024
records.summary_en: A US aircraft observed an oval or spherical shape for over two hours. The report did not identify it or state what happened after it was no longer visible.

records.title: DOW-UAP-D054, Mission Report, Mediterranean Sea, NA
records.summary_en: Military personnel observed a single object during a flight back to base over the Mediterranean Sea. They described it as triangular and metallic, but the report does not identify it.

records.title: DOW-UAP-D055, Mission Report, Syria, November 2016
records.summary_en: An American aircraft tracked an object flying low off the Syrian coast for about two minutes. It was seen passing between two ships, then disappeared from the crew's sight.

records.title: DOW-UAP-D056, Range Fouler Debrief, Arabian Sea, August 2020
records.summary_en: A military pilot lost a small object behind a cloud. When he resumed tracking it, he noticed two additional objects to its east.

records.title: DOW-UAP-D057, Range Fouler Reporting Form, Gulf of Aden, September 2020
records.summary_en: A military operator tracked a round object over the Gulf of Aden. It appeared white on the sensor, changed direction sharply several times, and remained unidentified.

records.title: DOW-UAP-D058, Range Fouler Debrief, NA, October 2020
records.summary_en: A military operator reported seeing two shiny objects, one circling the other. According to the report, both vanished in a fraction of a second, and the footage did not identify them.

records.title: DOW-UAP-D006, Mission Report, Arabian Gulf, 2020
records.summary_en: A U.S. military operator reported an unidentified phenomenon. The record’s heading lists the Arabian Gulf and 2020, but its location field says the Pacific Ocean. No event date is given.

records.title: DOW-UAP-D060, Mission Report, Arabian Gulf, August 2020
records.summary_en: A US military member reported a moving phenomenon in the Arabian Gulf. Dense clouds periodically interfered with video recording, and the report did not identify what it was.

records.title: DOW-UAP-D061, Mission Report, Arabian Gulf, August 2020
records.summary_en: A crew member aboard a military aircraft saw a group of objects moving along the coast of the Arabian Gulf. After about two minutes, clouds obscured them, and the crew could not locate them again.

records.title: DOW-UAP-D062, Mission Report, Strait of Hormuz, September 2020
records.summary_en: During a surveillance flight over the Strait of Hormuz, a military crew member reported seeing an unidentified phenomenon in camera footage. The report estimated its altitude at about 550 meters but gave no description of its appearance or movement.

records.title: DOW-UAP-D063, Mission Report, Strait of Hormuz, October 2020
records.summary_en: A military crew member reported seeing something unidentified in the Strait of Hormuz. The released report doesn’t describe it, and parts of the record are redacted.

records.title: DOW-UAP-D064, Mission Report, Iran, November 2020
records.summary_en: A military crew member reported two anomalies in video from an aircraft sensor, five minutes apart. The report says the second moved northwest but does not describe what appeared in the video.

records.title: DOW-UAP-D065, Mission Report, Arabian Gulf, July 2020
records.summary_en: A U.S. military operator reported three separate encounters in the Arabian Gulf on the same day. The record lists the times but does not describe what the operator saw.

records.title: DOW-UAP-D007, Mission Report, Arabian Gulf, 2020
records.summary_en: A military crew member tracked an object that looked like a balloon and drifted with the wind at an altitude of about nine kilometers. The report does not identify it.

records.title: DOW-UAP-D074, Mission Report, Syria, November 2023
records.summary_en: An aircrew member in Syria reported seeing a bouncy ball–like object descend and pass near the aircraft. It remained in view for about seven minutes, but its identity is unknown.

records.title: DOW-UAP-D075, Mission Report, Gulf of Aden, July 2024
records.summary_en: A military crew member spotted an object flying straight over the Gulf of Aden and tracked it until it was too far away. The report says it was faster than the aircraft, but gives no speeds or identification.

records.title: DOW-UAP-D008, Mission Report, Djibouti, 2025
records.summary_en: A U.S. military mission report documents a sighting of two round, white objects over the Mediterranean. The operator estimated their speed, but the report does not identify them.

records.title: DOW-UAP-PR019, Unresolved UAP Report, Middle East, May 2022
records.summary_en: A military sensor video shows a dot crossing the frame. The mission report suggested it might be a missile, but it is unclear what the object was or why that possibility was raised.

records.title: DOW-UAP-PR020, Unresolved UAP Report, Kuwait, May 2022
records.summary_en: A 2022 military image showed an elongated spot circled in red. The report described it moving from north toward northeast, but the operator couldn’t identify the phenomenon.

records.title: DOW-UAP-PR021, Unresolved UAP Report, Iraq, May 2022
records.summary_en: A brief military video from Iraq shows two shapes moving together. A mission report suggested they might be a Russian fighter jet, but offered no explanation.

records.title: DOW-UAP-PR022, Unresolved UAP Report, Syria, July 2022
records.summary_en: In a military video recorded over Syria, an object appears after about five seconds and moves across the top of the frame. The mission report says it traveled from north to south, but it’s unclear how those directions align.

records.title: DOW-UAP-PR023, Unresolved UAP Report, Iraq, December 2022
records.summary_en: Footage from a military sensor in Iraq shows a spot moving diagonally before leaving the frame. The record neither identifies it nor offers explanations that have been tested.

records.title: DOW-UAP-PR026, Unresolved UAP Report, United Arab Emirates, October 2023
records.summary_en: A patch that looked different from the rest of the image crossed the screen as a military sensor moved, exited on the left, and never reappeared.

records.title: DOW-UAP-PR027, Unresolved UAP Report, United Arab Emirates, October 2023
records.summary_en: The U.S. Department of War released footage captured by a military sensor in the United Arab Emirates. The sensor zoomed in on a spot, lost it, then found it again, but the report does not identify what it was.

records.title: DOW-UAP-PR028, Unresolved UAP Report, Greece, January 2024
records.summary_en: A sensor aboard a military aircraft over Greece displayed a blob that vanished from the standard image. When the operator returned to the first sensor, they couldn’t find it again.

records.title: DOW-UAP-PR029, Unresolved UAP Report, United Arab Emirates, June 2024
records.summary_en: Footage from a heat-sensing camera shows an inverted teardrop shape with a vertical streak beneath it. The viewer suggested it might be a reflection of something in the water.

records.title: DOW-UAP-PR031, Unresolved UAP Report, Syria, October 2024
records.summary_en: A short video from Syria shows a colorful blur at the edge of the frame, but the accompanying report describes a white ball of light. The record does not explain the discrepancy.

records.title: DOW-UAP-PR032, Unresolved UAP Report, Syria, October 2024
records.summary_en: A camera aboard a U.S. military aircraft in Syria recorded a white-and-red patch of light. The mission report described its shape, but the record doesn’t explain what caused it.

records.title: DOW-UAP-PR033, Unresolved UAP Report, Syria, October 2024
records.summary_en: A military camera in Syria recorded five seconds of video. The footage description mentions two orange shapes, while the accompanying report describes a white ball of light.

records.title: DOW-UAP-PR034, Unresolved UAP Report, Greece, October 2023
records.summary_en: Video from a military sensor shows a speck over the sea, marked by a blue box. The area became difficult to distinguish from the background, and the sensor lost track of it.

records.title: DOW-UAP-PR035, Unresolved UAP Report, Greece, October 2023
records.summary_en: A military sensor tracked a small spot moving over the sea in Greece toward land. When the background changed, the spot was no longer visible.

records.title: DOW-UAP-PR036, Unresolved UAP Report, Middle East, May 2020
records.summary_en: A bright spot appears in footage from a military camera. The camera zooms in, but its tracking marker can’t lock on. In the end, the camera loses sight of it.

records.title: DOW-UAP-PR037, Unresolved UAP Report, Middle East, 2020
records.summary_en: Footage from a military sensor shows a blob moving across the screen and disappearing. The report does not identify it or explain why it was submitted.

records.title: DOW-UAP-PR038, Unresolved UAP Report, Middle East, 2013
records.summary_en: A military video from the Middle East shows a star-shaped form moving and leaving a trail. It disappears, reappears after an edit, then leaves the frame elsewhere.

records.title: DOW-UAP-PR039, Unresolved UAP Report, Middle East, 2020
records.summary_en: A five-second video from the Arabian Gulf shows a speck moving in from the right and disappearing at the bottom. The record describes its movement but does not identify what caused it.

records.title: DOW-UAP-PR040, Unresolved UAP Report, Middle East, 2020
records.summary_en: Video from a military sensor in the Gulf shows a bright area marked with a white line. When the footage resumes, the sensor tracks it. What produced the area remains unknown.

records.title: DOW-UAP-PR041, Unresolved UAP Report, Middle East, 2020
records.summary_en: A military-camera video shows a patch that stands out from the background entering from the left. The camera tracks it for a minute and a half, but the report does not describe what appears in the footage.

records.title: DOW-UAP-PR042, Unresolved UAP Report, Middle East, 2020
records.summary_en: A military sensor tracked a blob over the Arabian Gulf as it blurred, disappeared, and returned. When the sensor switched imaging modes, the blob appeared elsewhere on the screen.

records.title: DOW-UAP-PR043, Unresolved UAP Report, Africa, 2025
records.summary_en: Video from a military sensor in Djibouti shows a small blip moving across the image and disappearing at the edge. The person who submitted the report offered no explanation of what they saw.

records.title: DOW-UAP-PR044, Unresolved UAP Report, Middle East, 2020
records.summary_en: A military sensor tracked an area that looked different from the background for about three minutes. When tracking stopped, the area left the frame. The video does not explain what it was.

records.title: DOW-UAP-PR045, Unresolved UAP Report, Middle East, 2020
records.summary_en: A military sensor tracked a dark area until it left the frame. It may have appeared larger because the aircraft moved closer to it, but its source remains unidentified.

records.title: DOW-UAP-PR046, Unresolved UAP Report, INDOPACOM, 2024
records.summary_en: A military sensor captured a soccer-ball-shaped object with three protrusions. The person who reported it offered no description, and the record does not explain what appears in the footage.

records.title: DOW-UAP-PR047, Unresolved UAP Report, INDOPACOM, 2023
records.summary_en: A military sensor in Japan tracked three areas for nearly two minutes as they held the same formation. The person who reported the video did not describe what they saw.

records.title: DOW-UAP-PR048, Unresolved UAP Report, INDOPACOM, 2024
records.summary_en: In a 2024 video, a military infrared sensor tracks an area that appears different from its surroundings. The person who filed the report did not describe what they saw.

records.title: DOW-UAP-PR049, Unresolved UAP Report, Department of the Army, 2026
records.summary_en: A military sensor recorded two points in North America that appeared distinct from the background and tracked them for nearly two minutes. Changes in zoom made them appear to grow and shrink, but the report does not explain what they were.

records.summary_en: An image from a military system shows two dark, elongated objects. The operator couldn’t identify the object they reported, and parts of the image were redacted before it was forwarded without the mission report.

records.title: FBI Photo B023
records.summary_en: An image from a military system showed a dark, elongated object near the reticle. The operator couldn’t identify it, and parts of the image and mission report are missing.

records.title: FBI Photo B024
records.summary_en: An image from a military system showed a dark object the operator couldn’t identify. The mission report was not provided, and parts of the original image were redacted.

records.title: FBI Photo B003
records.summary_en: An image from a military system shows a dark speck beside the reticle. The operator could not identify it, and parts of the image were redacted. The mission report was not included.

records.title: FBI Photo B004
records.summary_en: An image from a U.S. military system shows a small, dark object the operator could not identify. Parts were redacted, and the accompanying mission report was not submitted for review.

records.title: FBI Photo B005
records.summary_en: An image from a military system was sent for review after the operator couldn’t identify what it showed. Parts of it were redacted, and the mission document was not included.

records.title: FBI Photo B006
records.summary_en: An image from a military system showed two objects. The operator could not identify them, and parts of the image were redacted before it was sent for review.

records.title: FBI Photo B007
records.summary_en: An image from a U.S. military system showed a helicopter-like shape and a dark circle beneath the reticle. The operator couldn’t identify the circle, and the mission report was not submitted.

records.title: FBI Photo B008
records.summary_en: An image from a U.S. military system shows a dark object near the reticle. The operator couldn’t identify it, parts of the image were redacted, and the mission report was never provided.

records.title: FBI Photo B009
records.summary_en: An image from a military system shows a dark circle beside the crosshairs, but the operator couldn’t identify it. Parts of the image were redacted, and the mission report was not included.

records.title: NASA-UAP-D001, Apollo 12 Transcript, 1969
records.summary_en: Alan Bean saw flashes and particles in space near the Moon and wondered whether they were escaping from it. Hours later, the crew spotted floating fragments, and the light illuminating them went out.

records.title: NASA-UAP-D002, Apollo 17 Transcript, 1972
records.summary_en: During Apollo 17, the astronauts saw bright particles near their spacecraft, followed by a distant light that flashed once brightly and once dimly. Schmitt thought the light might have come from a rocket section that had separated, but the transcript does not identify it with certainty.

records.title: NASA-UAP-D004, Apollo 11 Technical Crew Debriefing, 1969
records.summary_en: Buzz Aldrin saw small flashes of light inside the Apollo 11 cabin with the lights off. He was sure he had seen them on the second night, but didn’t know what caused them.

records.title: NASA-UAP-D005, Apollo 17 Crew Debriefing for Science, 1973
records.summary_en: Apollo 17’s ultraviolet experiment detected a signal that resembled light from a hot star, even though no such star was visible in the region examined. The researcher suggested that starlight had reflected off dust in space, but some features of the measurement did not fit that explanation.

records.title: NASA-UAP-D006, Apollo 17 Technical Crew Debriefing, 1973
records.summary_en: Harrison Schmitt said he repeatedly saw flashes of light on the way to the Moon. They disappeared when the crew covered their eyes, then returned before he fell asleep.

records.title: NASA-UAP-D007, Skylab Technical Crew Debriefing 1973
records.summary_en: Astronauts spotted a bright red light near the space station. They thought it was a satellite, but couldn’t identify it and never saw it again.

records.title: NASA-UAP-VM001, Apollo 12, 1969
records.summary_en: A NASA archive photo from the Apollo 12 mission shows a highlighted area above the lunar horizon. NASA says unidentified objects can be seen there but does not say what they are.

records.title: NASA-UAP-VM002, Apollo 12, 1969
records.summary_en: An Apollo 12 photo marks two areas above the lunar horizon. NASA said the markings help viewers find them but did not identify the phenomena.

records.title: NASA-UAP-VM003, Apollo 12, 1969
records.summary_en: A photo from the Apollo 12 landing site marks an area above the lunar horizon, near the image’s right edge. NASA says unidentified phenomena are visible there, but the description doesn’t say what they look like.

records.title: NASA-UAP-VM004, Apollo 12, 1969
records.summary_en: A photo from the Apollo 12 landing site highlights an area above the lunar horizon, slightly left of center. NASA says the marking helps viewers locate the spot but does not describe what appears there.

records.title: NASA-UAP-VM005, Apollo 12, 1969
records.summary_en: Five areas above the lunar horizon are marked in a photograph from the Apollo 12 landing site. NASA says the markings help viewers find them, but don’t identify what appears there.

records.title: NASA-UAP-VM006, Apollo 17, 1972
records.summary_en: Three points arranged in a triangle appear in an Apollo 17 photograph. The government is examining the original film, but what caused them remains unknown.

records.title: State Department UAP Cable 001, Papua New Guinea, January 28, 1985
records.summary_en: Residents in Papua New Guinea were alarmed by lights, noise, and white streaks in the sky. A pilot said an instrument aboard his plane detected fast-moving aircraft, but their identity was never established.

records.title: State Department UAP Cable 002, Kazakhstan, January 31, 1994
records.summary_en: Pilots over Kazakhstan watched a light circle and disappear beyond the horizon. The plane passed beneath the trails it left behind, but it remains unclear what the light was or whether the photographs reached the embassy.

records.title: State Department UAP Cable 003, Tbilisi, Georgia, October 30, 2001
records.summary_en: Georgia reported that Russian aircraft had bombed a mountainous region. Russia denied the reports, and a Georgian official said they might have referred to UFOs.

records.title: State Department UAP Cable 004, Ashgabat, Turkmenistan, November 5, 2004
records.summary_en: A U.S. representative described a group of UFO enthusiasts in Turkmenistan as trusted partners. He was surprised by the group’s reputation and linked it to widespread interest in UFOs across the country.

records.title: State Department UAP Cable 005, Mexico, September 16, 2003
records.summary_en: Experts presented bodies in Mexico’s Congress that they claimed were extraterrestrial, along with videos of pilots who saw fast-moving objects. The hearing did not specify what tests had been conducted on the bodies, what the videos showed, or whether the bill passed.

records.title: USPER Statement about UAP Sighting
records.summary_en: A helicopter tried to catch a glowing orb that approached, then sped away. Later, the crew repeatedly saw lights switching on and off over the mountains.

records.title: FBI September 2023 Sighting - Composite Sketch
records.summary_en: Witnesses in the United States described a bronze-colored metallic object that appeared out of a light and vanished immediately. The FBI released an image of the location with an illustration combining the witnesses’ accounts.

records.title: FBI September 2023 Sighting - Serial 003
records.summary_en: An American citizen told the FBI about an encounter with an object at a test site. He described it as metallic and bronze-colored, but the record doesn’t say what happened or what the object was.

records.title: FBI September 2023 Sighting - Serial 004
records.summary_en: A worker and two colleagues saw a large, silent object in the sky near a test site. It vanished after a few seconds. Another worker said he had seen it, too.

records.title: FBI September 2023 Sighting - Serial 005
records.summary_en: A man told the FBI he saw a bright light near a test facility. It stayed fixed, but a man in another car couldn’t see it.

records.title: Western US Event
records.summary_en: Two agents followed lights that seemed to belong to a car, but they left the road and vanished. About half an hour later, a kite-shaped object appeared, and a flashlight beam aimed at it seemed to stop in front of empty space.

records.title: 65 HS1-834228961 62-HQ-83894 Serial 153
records.summary_en: The FBI file lists two photographs of flying saucers reportedly seen near Oak Ridge, Tennessee. A newspaper clipping about the same saucers was filed with them, but the supplied material does not include the images or the article.

records.title: CIA-UAP-017, Placement on High Alert Due to Perceived Aggressive Foreign Posturing
records.summary_en: A report by the U.S. intelligence agency described a saucer-shaped object over Harare Airport. Beams appeared to shoot from it, its lights changed color, and it rose and vanished.

records.title: DOW-UAP-D084, US Army-Flying-Saucer-Study 1949
records.summary_en: After radio reports of flying saucers, the U.S. Army investigated whether a foreign country was involved. Later, it asked investigators to check the accuracy of a radio broadcaster’s statements.

records.title: FBI-UAP-D002, FD-1057, Unresolved UAP Report, Colorado Springs, 2022
records.summary_en: Five people saw a white object over Cheyenne Mountain. It stayed in place as parts of its surface moved, then vanished in an instant.

records.title: FBI-UAP-D003, Digital Rendering, Unresolved UAP Report, Colorado Springs, 2022
records.summary_en: The FBI released an illustration connected to an incident near Colorado Springs in 2022. It was based on a first-person account in another report, but the record does not say what the person described or what the illustration depicts.

records.title: FBI-UAP-D009, FD-302-67, “Northeastern Orb Sighting,” 2026
records.summary_en: A person and their partner saw two red orbs moving together above the yard. Before they vanished, they appeared to merge into a single light.

records.title: FBI-UAP-D010, FD-302-71, “Northeastern Orb Sighting,” 2026
records.summary_en: A man and a neighbor saw two glowing orbs move behind trees and a house. In a garbled passage in the document, one light appears to enter the other before both disappear.

records.title: FBI-UAP-D011, D/FBI Correspondence Referral, 1949
records.summary_en: The Reverend Charles Barnes described four beams of light converging over the Cascade Range, where an explosion-like image appeared. The FBI director forwarded his letter to the U.S. Atomic Energy Commission.

records.title: FBI-UAP-PR003, “Orbs Over the Pond,” 2024
records.summary_en: A person in the northeastern United States filmed a light above a pool. It appeared to change shape, and smaller points seemed to break away from it before it disappeared about 45 minutes later.

records.title: FBI-UAP-PR004, “Northeastern Orb Sighting,” 2025
records.summary_en: A couple saw two red spheres moving together above the trees. They seemed to merge before disappearing, and the report does not explain what they were.

records.title: ICA-UAP-D001, Analysis: Colorado Springs UAP Incident, 2022
records.summary_en: Five soldiers saw a large white shape hovering above a mountain in Colorado before it vanished. Investigators suggested that sunlight reflected off snow may have illuminated clouds, but they could not determine whether that was what happened.
In 1952, General Sanford said radar reports and pilot sightings made it impossible to dismiss every report as a malfunction. To him, the phenomenon remained a mystery.

records.title: CIA-UAP-002, Scientific Advisory Panel on Unidentified Flying Objects, Report, 1952-1953
records.summary_en: A group of scientists who examined reports of flying saucers in 1953 found no direct threat. They worried that the reports and the panic surrounding them could obscure real dangers.

records.title: CIA-UAP-003, The Central Intelligence Agency and Overhead Reconnaissance; The U-2 and OXCART Programs, 1954-1974
records.summary_en: A U-2 was shot down over the Soviet Union in 1960, and its pilot, Francis Gary Powers, was captured. The incident exposed the photo-reconnaissance program, prompting changes to flight procedures and the withdrawal of crews.

records.title: CIA-UAP-004, CASE 17708 (CLOSED) and DR. Leon Davidson
records.summary_en: The CIA told an investigator that records of a message linked to space, along with the device that transmitted it, had been destroyed. An internal memo described the response as evasive and unfair.

records.title: CIA-UAP-005, German Scientist's Article on 'Flying Discs'
records.summary_en: A German scientist proposed that flying saucers could rise using rotating cylinders or turbines that altered the airflow around the aircraft. The report documented the idea but offered no evidence that it had been tested or worked.

records.title: CIA-UAP-006, Sighting Of Unconventional Aircraft
records.summary_en: Three American passengers saw a glowing triangular craft rise and spin near Baku. A crew member lowered the curtains on the orders of a Soviet security officer.

records.title: CIA-UAP-007, Current Status Of Unidentified Flying Objects (UFO) Project.
records.summary_en: The US Air Force investigated reports of things seen in the sky and compared them with information about the weather, stars, aircraft, and balloons. About one in ten remained unexplained.

records.title: CIA-UAP-008, Speculative Paper By N Kardashev and A Sakharov on Charged Mass in Space at Conference on Origins Of Life, Armenia, 6-8 September 1971/Low Scientific Level Of Other Soviet Papers
records.summary_en: Two Soviet scientists proposed that charged matter might collapse and then reappear somewhere else in space. An American listener thought the idea was wild but grounded in sound physics.

records.title: CIA-UAP-009, Unknown Flying Objects Observed Over Budapest
records.summary_en: A CIA report concerned sightings of flying objects over Budapest in 1957. Its summary does not describe the objects or explain what they were.

records.title: CIA-UAP-010, Report on Conversations with Soviet Scientists on Subject of Unidentified Flying Objects in the USSR
records.summary_en: In 1967, an American scientist traveled to the Soviet Union and spoke with researchers about UFO sightings. A CIA document records the talks, but its summary doesn’t say what was said.

records.title: CIA-UAP-011, The Sary Shagan Weapons Testing Range
records.summary_en: A CIA report on a Soviet test site mentioned an unidentified sighting in the sky. The document does not describe what was seen or explain why the sighting was mentioned.

records.title: CIA-UAP-012, Combating Fatigue In Crewmembers
records.summary_en: Aeroflot pilots reported flashes of light during night flights. A Soviet biologist linked them to particles from space, but the report did not establish that those particles caused the flashes.

records.title: CIA-UAP-013, Report of Unusual Flying Object Sightings and Attendant Scientific Activity
records.summary_en: A letter from a niece in Budapest described fast-moving objects and included a drawing of a possible route to Moscow. The CIA report did not explain what people had seen.

records.title: CIA-UAP-014, British activity in the Field of "Unidentified Flying Objects"
records.summary_en: British officers and pilots saw a flying saucer during an air show in Yorkshire. The sighting made the newspapers and worried the scientist handling the case, but a memo does not explain what the object was.

records.title: CIA-UAP-015, Project Blue Book Special Report No. 14 (Analysis of Reports of Unidentified Aerial Objects)
records.summary_en: A US Air Force report came with a CIA cover. The summary mentions a handwritten note on the first page but doesn’t reveal what it says.

records.title: CIA-UAP-016, Sightings of Unidentified Flying Objects in Ladakh, Nepal, Sikkim and Bhutan
records.summary_en: A CIA report lists seven UFO sightings between February and March 1968, across four places. The summary does not describe what was seen.

records.title: CIA-UAP-018, Report of Unusual Flying Object Sightings and Attendant Scientific Activity
records.summary_en: An unidentified flying object was reported in Hungary in 1955. The summary says the information came in a letter exchanged by relatives living in the United States and Budapest, but does not describe the object.

records.title: CIA-UAP-019, Australian Dept of Defense Scientific and Intel Aspects of the UFO Problem
records.summary_en: A 1971 document describes an Australian review of the US Air Force’s UFO project. The record does not specify what the review examined or found.

records.title: CIA-UAP-D001, Intelligence Information Report, USSR, 1973
records.summary_en: At a Soviet test site, a man watched a green circle expand as rings appeared around it. Within minutes, the color vanished without a sound.

records.title: DOE-UAP-D001, Enhanced PANTEX Imagery
records.summary_en: A Department of Energy report on an unidentified-object incident at Pantex includes an enhanced image from a ground-surveillance radar tower. Parts of the record were redacted, and the source does not describe what the image shows.

records.title: DOE-UAP-D002, James Tuck Correspondence, 1970s
records.summary_en: After reading about large atmospheric vortices in a book, James Tuck asked for instructions on simulating atomic explosions.

records.title: DOE-UAP-D003, Pajarito Astronomers Invitation, 1986
records.summary_en: An astronomy club invited a physicist associated with Los Alamos National Laboratory to speak about UFOs. The lab clarified that the event was not held on its behalf, and it has no record of the topics discussed.

records.title: DOW-UAP-D017, UAP Reported at Sandia Base, 1948-1950
records.summary_en: After a fireball was reported over New Mexico, researchers collected particles from the air. They found copper, then three tiny spheres that reacted to cobalt, but could not determine whether they came from the fireball.

records.title: DOW-UAP-D020, Mission Report, Iraq, 2023
records.summary_en: Fighter pilots in Iraq saw bright lights moving at high speed. One tracked them on the aircraft’s system for about 20 seconds, until they dimmed and disappeared.

records.title: DOW-UAP-D077, AARO Unresolved Case Analysis Update: Western United States Event
records.summary_en: Unidentified phenomena were reported for two days near a sensitive site in the western United States. As of June 2026, the case remains unresolved.

records.title: DOW-UAP-D078, Notional Map: Western United States Event
records.summary_en: Federal agents reported four incidents in the western United States in October 2023. A Department of War document depicts them in an overhead illustration but does not detail what happened.

records.title: DOW-UAP-D079, Narrative Statement 1, Western United States Event, 2023
records.summary_en: Several U.S. law enforcement agents reported seeing unidentified phenomena in the American West over two days in October 2023. One gave a personal account, but the excerpt provided does not describe what he saw.

records.title: DOW-UAP-D080, Narrative Statement 2, Western United States Event, 2023
records.summary_en: Several federal agents reported unidentified phenomena in the Western United States over two days in October 2023. The summary mentions a firsthand account from one of them but does not say what the agent saw.

records.title: DOW-UAP-D081, Narrative Statement 3, Western United States Event, 2023
records.summary_en: Several U.S. law enforcement agents reported seeing phenomena they couldn’t identify over two days in October 2023. The record includes an account from one of them, but doesn’t say what the phenomena looked like.

records.title: DOW-UAP-D082, Narrative Statement 4, Western United States Event, 2023
records.summary_en: Several agents working for the U.S. government reported seeing unidentified phenomena over two days in the western United States. The summary says one of them gave a firsthand account but does not specify what he saw.

records.title: DOW-UAP-D083, Narrative Statement 5, Western United States Event, 2023
records.summary_en: Several federal agents reported unidentified phenomena in the western United States over two days in October 2023. The record includes one agent’s firsthand account but does not specify what they saw.

records.title: DOW-UAP-D085 Transmission-of-CIA-Scientific-Advisory-Panel-Rept 1953
records.summary_en: In 1953, a copy of a CIA report on unidentified flying objects was sent to the U.S. secretary of defense. The record does not say what the report concluded.

records.title: DOW-UAP-D086, USNavy-Report-of-Flying-Discs 1948
records.summary_en: A 1948 memo asked Navy stations to report flying-saucer incidents to the Air Force and a naval intelligence office.

records.title: DOW-UAP-D087, U.S. Air Force Analysis of Flying Objects in the United States, 1-100
records.summary_en: Three witnesses in California saw two objects, then watched a third appear and circle one of them in a sharp turn. They said the objects moved quickly against the wind and disappeared, but they could not identify them.

records.title: DOW-UAP-D088, U.S. Air Force Analysis of Flying Objects in the United States, 101-172
records.summary_en: A fireball exploded over Kansas in 1948, leaving a smoke trail in the sky for an hour. Stones found in a field supported the theory that it was a meteor, though a letter to the military suggested it might have been a rocket headed for the Moon.

records.title: DOW-UAP-PR050, "4 UAP Formation Iran 26 Aug 2022 over water [CALLSIGN]"
records.summary_en: In footage from a military sensor, four blips move in from the left and disappear near the bottom. Another appears in the upper-left corner, but the description does not identify them.

records.title: DOW-UAP-PR051, "Syrian UAP instant acceleration"
records.summary_en: A military sensor tracked a spot, then stopped tracking it. The spot shot off the screen. The video was edited before it was uploaded, but the reason is unknown.

records.title: DOW-UAP-PR052, "UAP USO Formation [CALLSIGN] (Mission)"
records.summary_en: A military sensor video shows four spots blurring and then coming back into clearer view. The video was digitally altered before it was uploaded to a military network, but what was changed and what the spots are remain unknown.

records.title: DOW-UAP-PR053, "Cigar Shaped or Fast Spherical UAP clip 15 OCT 22"
records.summary_en: A spot crosses the frame in a military video, and the clip replays the moment twice in slow motion. The video was digitally altered before it was uploaded, but it’s unclear what changed or what the spot is.

records.title: DOW-UAP-PR054, "Spherical UAP Erratic movement [CALLSIGN] (Mission) 2022"
records.summary_en: Military footage shows a camera tracking a blob. The video was digitally altered before it was uploaded, significantly changing how the blob appears to move.

records.title: DOW-UAP-PR055, "Spherical UAP over AFG in and out of clouds 23 Nov 2020"
records.summary_en: In an edited version of a military video, a spot moves in one direction. In the original, it moves another way. The video was altered, but it remains unclear what the spot is or what caused it to move.

records.title: DOW-UAP-PR056, "Spherical UAP pulsing over water [CALLSIGN]"
records.summary_en: A prominent region remains near the center of a military video even as the sensor briefly changes the image’s appearance. The video was edited before it was uploaded, and what it shows remains unknown.

records.title: DOW-UAP-PR057a, "Spherical UAP in clouds"
records.summary_en: A blip disappears into the background of a military sensor video, then reappears when the image is enlarged. The footage does not reveal what was captured.

records.title: DOW-UAP-PR058, "[CALLSIGN] (Mission) UAP"
records.summary_en: A video uploaded to a military network shows a sensor tracking an area on screen for several minutes. Captions say the image was altered, but it’s unclear what appeared there.

records.title: DOW-UAP-PR059, "NAG UAP 1 Jun 20"
records.summary_en: A military sensor tracked an area that stood out in the image until it left the frame. The video was later released to the public, but it does not reveal what the spot was.

records.title: DOW-UAP-PR060, "Spherical UAP [CALLSIGN] 2021/04/12 obj 2"
records.summary_en: A blob crossed the military camera’s view, disappeared, then reappeared. The official description recounts how the camera tracked it but does not identify it.

records.title: DOW-UAP-PR061, "Spherical UAP [CALLSIGN] 2021/04/12 vid 0"
records.summary_en: A military sensor tracked a spot and centered it in the frame. After the sensor changed modes, the spot became difficult to distinguish.

records.title: DOW-UAP-PR062, "Spherical UAP [CALLSIGN] 2021/04/12 vid 1"
records.summary_en: A military sensor tracked an area that looked different from its surroundings for nearly five minutes. The record describes the tracking but doesn’t identify what appeared in the image.

records.title: DOW-UAP-PR063, "Spherical UAP [CALLSIGN] 2021/04/12 vid 2"
records.summary_en: The sensor tracked a distinct area in the image for about 49 seconds, then turned away. The video’s title suggests a sphere, but the official description does not identify what appears in the footage.

records.title: DOW-UAP-PR064, "AFSOC Kabul UAP Jul 2017"
records.summary_en: A dark-and-light spot moves from left to right in a short military video. The title mentions Kabul, but nothing identifies the spot or confirms where or when the video was filmed.

records.title: DOW-UAP-PR065, "USCG C-144 Tyndall UAP 2 TIC TAC IR hot 24 April 2024"
records.summary_en: A Coast Guard sensor kept a prominent area in frame for about half a minute. When the sensor turned left, the area slipped out of view on the right. It’s unclear what was there.

records.title: DOW-UAP-PR066, "USCG C-144 Tyndall UAP 1 TIC TAC IR hot 24 April 2024"
records.summary_en: Two spots appear in a video from a Coast Guard sensor. The second time, the sensor moves to follow one, but the spot slips out of view.

records.title: DOW-UAP-PR067, "Multiple Spherical UAP USO near Sub. [CALLSIGN] 2022/03/25 in and out of water"
records.summary_en: In a military video, the camera turns to follow spots that disappear from view and then return. The video was released as part of an official record, but it doesn’t explain what they are.

records.title: DOW-UAP-PR068, "IIR 1 666 S0151 23/Video Footage of Unidentified Aerial Phenomenon (UAP) captured by fifth generation aircraft on 20 Jan 23"
records.summary_en: A military sensor tracks a spot moving in and out of frame, then a second spot appears. The video likely came from a sensor aboard a U.S. military vehicle, but what it shows remains unknown.

records.title: DOW-UAP-PR069, "F/A-18 FLIR UAP"
records.summary_en: A military sensor marked an area that looked different from its surroundings, then lost track of it. The video does not identify what was there or explain why tracking stopped.

records.title: DOW-UAP-PR070, "IIR 1 655 S0301 23/Eglin AFB Aircrew Observed Unidentified Aerial Phenomena (UAP) on 13 Feb 23"
records.summary_en: A military sensor tracked an area that looked different from its surroundings. After 22 seconds, it was no longer clearly distinct, but the record does not identify it or explain the change.

records.title: DOW-UAP-PR071, "USAF ANG F-16C (callsign [CALLSIGN]) Shoots Down UAP over Lake Huron with [Weapon System], 12 Feb 2023"
records.summary_en: A 2023 military video shows two points that appear to meet, then one scatters into rays. What the video actually shows remains unknown.

records.title: DOW-UAP-PR072, "ADMINISTRATIVE REVISION: IIR 1777 J0032 22 Kazakhstan - UAP in the vicinity of Karaganda International Airport"
records.summary_en: A video whose title links it to an airport in Kazakhstan shows a light with trailing streaks. It was digitally altered before being uploaded to a classified network, but what changed and what produced the light remain unknown.

records.title: DOW-UAP-PR073, IIR 1 655 S0053 23/Several Unidentified Aerial Phenomenon Encountered In The Vicinity of Columbus OH"
records.summary_en: In footage from a military sensor, a second dot crosses the frame, disappears behind a redacted area, then briefly reappears. The dots’ identities are unknown.

records.title: DOW-UAP-PR074, "[CALLSIGN] (Mission)HD 20220613"
records.summary_en: A military sensor tracked areas that disappeared from view. After more than a minute with no image, four dots appeared, but the video does not identify them.

records.title: DOW-UAP-PR075, "09JUN2021 [Platform] observed UAP in the ECS"
records.summary_en: A military sensor tracked an area that looked unusual over the East China Sea, then lost it. What the sensor captured remains unknown.

records.title: DOW-UAP-PR076, "03 January 2021 [CALLSIGN] (Mission) observes UAP"
records.summary_en: A spot appears in military footage after a long stretch with no image. The sensor tracks it and closes in, but its identity remains unknown.

records.title: DOW-UAP-PR077, "2 November 2020 [CALLSIGN] [CALLSIGN] Observes and tracks UAP 1 of 2"
records.summary_en: A military sensor tracks an area that grows more pronounced on screen, then shifts to another. The official description does not explain what produced either one.

records.title: DOW-UAP-PR078, "2 November 2020 [CALLSIGN] [CALLSIGN] Observes and tracks UAP 2 of 2"
records.summary_en: In a 2020 video, a military camera tracks a spot that grows brighter, then turns to follow another. The office that reviewed the video did not determine what produced them.

records.title: DOW-UAP-PR079, "29 October 2020 [CALLSIGN] (Mission) observes 3 fast moving UAP's"
records.summary_en: A second spot appears in footage from a military sensor, which turns to track it. The spot later becomes less distinct; what the spots were remains unknown.

records.title: DOW-UAP-PR080, "20 October 2020 [CALLSIGN] [CALLSIGN] Observes UAP"
records.summary_en: In a 2020 video, patches that looked different from their surroundings crossed the frame. A military camera tried to track them, but the official record does not identify them.

records.title: DOW-UAP-PR081, "18 Oct 2020 [CALLSIGN] observes UAP"
records.summary_en: After nearly a minute of blank footage, a spot crosses a military video diagonally and disappears in about six seconds. It’s unclear what the video shows.

records.title: DOW-UAP-PR082, "16 OCT 2020 [CALLSIGN] views UAP"
records.summary_en: A mark crosses a military sensor image in about a second. The record describes its movement but does not identify what caused it.

records.title: DOW-UAP-PR083, "7 October 2020 [CALLSIGN] observes UAP"
records.summary_en: In footage from a military sensor, a blur enters the frame and grows harder to distinguish. Near the end, a second appears, and the sensor turns toward it.

records.title: DOW-UAP-PR084, "17 Sept 2020 [CALLSIGN] observes UAP"
records.summary_en: After 25 seconds of blank footage, a feature that stands out from its surroundings crosses a military-camera video in about two seconds. The official description recounts its passage but does not identify what appears in the footage.

records.title: DOW-UAP-PR085, "16 Sept 2020 [CALLSIGN] [CALLSIGN] observes UAP"
records.summary_en: A blob appeared in a 2020 military video. The camera zoomed in and tracked it until it left the frame, but the record does not identify it.

records.title: DOW-UAP-PR086, "UAP from Dec 2019 (East Coast)"
records.summary_en: In a video linked to a 2019 incident on the U.S. East Coast, a military sensor tracks an area that looks different from its surroundings and changes how the image is displayed. The final 10 seconds contain no image content, and the cause of the difference is unknown.

records.title: DOW-UAP-PR087, "05 September 2020 [CALLSIGN] UAP"
records.summary_en: In footage from a military sensor, a light-and-dark patch crosses the screen three times. What caused it is unknown.

records.title: DOW-UAP-PR088, "31 AUG [CALLSIGN] [CALLSIGN] Observes UAP"
records.summary_en: After a minute and 20 seconds of blank screen, a mark crossed the sensor’s display. Later, the sensor changed direction and tracked another mark, but no one determined what they showed.

records.title: DOW-UAP-PR089, "31 AUG [CALLSIGN] [CALLSIGN] Observes UAP part2"
records.summary_en: In footage from a military sensor, blips appear and disappear. One moves out of frame as the sensor tracks it. Then the screen stays blank. It’s unclear what the blips were.

records.title: DOW-UAP-PR090, "24 AUG 2020 [CALLSIGN] (Mission) Observes UAP"
records.summary_en: A military camera tracked a bright spot, zoomed in, and watched it disappear from the frame and return. The video was reviewed as part of a collection of records, but it remains unclear what it shows.

records.title: DOW-UAP-PR091, "21 AUG [CALLSIGN] Observes UAP in Persian Gulf"
records.summary_en: An area that looked different from the rest of the image crossed a military sensor’s screen. The sensor turned to track it, and the area later blended into the video’s grain. What caused it to appear is unknown.

records.title: DOW-UAP-PR092, "08 AUG 2020 [CALLSIGN] [CALLSIGN] UAP observation"
records.summary_en: A blob appeared in footage from a military sensor, then disappeared offscreen. The sensor tracked it, but what the image showed remains unknown.

records.title: DOW-UAP-PR093, "May 05 2020 Gulf of Arabia [CALLSIGN] (Platform) Dual UAP"
records.summary_en: A military sensor video shows patches that look different from their surroundings appearing and disappearing. The footage was released among records reviewed in response to a request from members of Congress, but what it shows remains unknown.

records.title: DOW-UAP-PR094, "[CALLSIGN] (Mission) - HD 2020-02-13"
records.summary_en: A spot crossed the screen in a military video, and a sensor tracked it. When the sensor switched to a different imaging mode, the spot blurred into the background. When it returned to the previous mode, the spot reappeared.

records.title: DOW-UAP-PR095, "May 05 2020 Gulf of Arabia [CALLSIGN] (Platform) Dual UAP"
records.summary_en: A military sensor zooms in on an area that looks like several spots. They move across the screen and disappear at its edge, but the video offers no explanation of what they were.

records.title: DOW-UAP-PR096, "HH11 03 July 2018 UAPs"
records.summary_en: In footage from a military sensor, two points enter the frame. When the sensor zooms in, one disappears and the other looks like three.

records.title: DOW-UAP-PR097, "Hi-Res: [CALLSIGN] Observes UAP on 25SEP19 at 2135Z"
records.summary_en: A 2019 military video shows a blip as a sensor zooms in and tracks it. Enlarged, it appears to comprise several areas. Later, the screen flashes black and white. What was captured is unknown.

records.title: DOW-UAP-PR098, "UFOs in formation over Persian Gulf?"
records.summary_en: A military video shows a patch splitting into several spots as the sensor zooms in, disappearing, then returning. No one knows what produced it.

records.title: DOW-UAP-PR099, "Hi-Res: [CALLSIGN] Observes UAP on 25SEP19 at 1715Z"
records.summary_en: In footage from a military sensor, areas appear and disappear as the sensor tracks them. The screen flashes black, but the record does not identify what appears in the image.

records.title: FBI-UAP-D001, FD-302, Unresolved UAP Report, Colorado Springs, 2022
records.summary_en: Five soldiers saw a silent white object hovering over a mountain in Colorado. They looked away briefly to get a phone, but when they looked back, the object had vanished.

records.title: FBI-UAP-D004, FD-1057-02, Northeastern United States, 2024
records.summary_en: A man sent the FBI videos of lights he had seen near his home over several years. A neighbor to the south said he had seen lights near the trees, too.

records.title: FBI-UAP-D005, FD-1057-04, Northeastern United States, 2024
records.summary_en: A man saw a light in his yard split into a triangle. The lights vanished as soon as his phone’s flash went off while he was taking a picture.

records.title: FBI-UAP-D006, FD-1057-05, Northeastern United States, 2024
records.summary_en: A resident reported seeing unidentified phenomena repeatedly over three years and led FBI agents to a wooded area. He showed them a video and offered to let them install equipment and arrange an evening visit.

records.title: FBI-UAP-D007, FD-1057-06, Northeastern United States, 2024
records.summary_en: Two FBI agents saw lights move and vanish near a home. A white light above a red one disappeared, then reappeared in the same spot.

records.title: FBI-UAP-D008, FD-1057-07, Northeastern United States, 2024
records.summary_en: Two FBI agents returned to the area where they had seen an unidentified phenomenon. They searched the site and found nothing unusual, but the report does not say what they saw earlier.

records.title: FBI-UAP-D012, Newark Field Office, 1952-1967
records.summary_en: A couple and their two children saw a silver object over their New Jersey home in November 1957. It disappeared, returned as dusk approached, and remained unidentified in the report.

records.title: FBI-UAP-D013, Washington State ‘UFO’ Investigation, 1952-1960
records.summary_en: In Richland, Washington, a witness saw a flickering light that seemed nearly motionless. He said it moved east and disappeared beyond the horizon in about 10 seconds. He thought it might have been a transparent balloon.

records.title: FBI-UAP-D014, Digital Rendering, Narrative Statement 1-1, Western United States Event, 2023
records.summary_en: A federal agent described an unidentified incident near a security facility, and the FBI created an image based on the account. The record does not say what the agent saw or what the image depicts.

records.title: FBI-UAP-D015, Digital Rendering, Narrative Statement 1-2, Western United States Event, 2023
records.summary_en: A federal agent described an unusual two-day incident near a sensitive site in the western United States. At the request of the U.S. Department of War, the FBI made a drawing, but the record doesn’t specify what the agent saw.

records.title: FBI-UAP-D016, Digital Rendering, Narrative Statement 2-1, Western United States Event, 2023
records.summary_en: The FBI created an image based on a federal agent’s firsthand account of an incident near a sensitive security site. The incident lasted two days, but the information released does not say what the agent saw or what the image depicts.

records.title: FBI-UAP-D017, Digital Rendering, Narrative Statement 2-2, Western United States Event, 2023
records.summary_en: In October 2023, an unidentified phenomenon was reported near a security site in the western United States over two days. In 2026, the FBI created an image based on a federal agent’s description. It was not a photograph of the event.

records.title: FBI-UAP-D018, Digital Rendering, Narrative Statement 2-3, Western United States Event, 2023
records.summary_en: A federal agent described a two-day incident near a security site in the western United States. In 2026, the FBI created an artist’s rendering based on his account.

records.title: FBI-UAP-D019, Digital Rendering, Narrative Statement 2-4, Western United States Event, 2023
records.summary_en: A federal agent described a two-day incident near a sensitive security site in the western United States. The FBI created an image based on the account, but the released details don’t say what the agent saw.

records.title: FBI-UAP-D020, Digital Rendering, Narrative Statement 2-5, Western United States Event, 2023
records.summary_en: A federal agent reported unidentified phenomena near a secure site over two days. The FBI created an image based on the agent’s account, but the record does not say what the agent saw.

records.title: FBI-UAP-D021, Digital Rendering, Narrative Statement 1-3, Western United States Event, 2023
records.summary_en: An unidentified phenomenon was reported over two days near a site considered sensitive to national security in the western United States. The FBI created an image based on an agent’s account, but the released material does not say what the agent saw or what the image depicts.

records.title: FBI-UAP-D022, Digital Rendering, Narrative Statement 2-6, Western United States Event, 2026
records.summary_en: A federal law enforcement agent described an unidentified phenomenon near a sensitive site in the western United States over two days in October 2023. The FBI created a computer-generated image based on the agent’s account, not a photograph of the event.

records.title: FBI-UAP-D023, Digital Rendering, Narrative Statement 2-7, Western United States Event, 2023
records.summary_en: A federal agent described a two-day incident near a national security site in the western United States. The FBI created an image based on the agent’s account, but the record doesn’t say what the agent saw.

records.title: FBI-UAP-PR001, “Triangle Orbs,” Northeastern United States, 2021
records.summary_en: A person filmed a light near the horizon that first appeared to be a single object, then seemed to become several moving lights. It’s unclear what the lights were.

records.title: FBI-UAP-PR002, “Red Orb Rotation,” Northeastern United States, 2022
records.summary_en: A person in the northeastern United States filmed two bright red lights near the horizon. The lower light appears to move slowly around the upper one, but what caused the motion is unknown.

records.title: FBI-UAP-PR005, Digital Recreation, Narrative Statement 3-1, Western United States Event, 2023
records.summary_en: The FBI created a computer-generated visualization based on an agent’s report of a two-day incident near a sensitive security site. The summary does not say what the agent saw or what appears in the video.

records.title: FBI-UAP-PR006, Digital Recreation, Narrative Statement 3-2, Western United States Event, 2023
records.summary_en: A federal agent reported an unidentified phenomenon near a sensitive site in the western United States over two days. The FBI later made a video to illustrate the account, but it does not document the event.

records.title: NASA-UAP-D008, Apollo 12 Medical Debriefing - Tape 12, 1969
records.summary_en: Three Apollo 12 astronauts reported flashes of light as they tried to fall asleep. NASA concluded the lights were part of their vision, not caused by an external source.

records.title: NASA-UAP-D009, Apollo 17 Audio Excerpt, December 7, 1972
records.summary_en: The Apollo 17 crew saw glowing particles near the spacecraft and a detached rocket section. The particles glittered and drifted away from it; the crew suggested they might have been paint flakes or ice.

records.title: NASA-UAP-D010, Mercury Atlas 9 Audio Excerpt, May 15, 1963
records.summary_en: Gordon Cooper saw white specks with a greenish tint in space and called them “John’s fireflies.” NASA determined they were frozen water droplets reflecting sunlight.

records.title: NASA-UAP-D011, Mercury Atlas 9 Audio Excerpt, May 15, 1963
records.summary_en: Gordon Cooper saw white, glowing particles drifting away from his spacecraft as dawn approached. Later, after deploying equipment with flashing lights, he described firefly-like objects. The recording does not identify the particles.

records.title: NASA-UAP-D012, Mercury Atlas 8 Audio Excerpt, October 3, 1962
records.summary_en: Wally Schirra described white flecks that seemed to emerge from the spacecraft cabin and drift away. Later, he saw a flash in the window and guessed it might be related to sunset.

records.title: NASA-UAP-D013, Mercury Atlas 7, May 24, 1962
records.summary_en: During his flight aboard Aurora 7, Scott Carpenter saw white, reflective particles. They looked like snowflakes, and some seemed to move faster than the spacecraft.

records.title: NASA-UAP-D014, Mercury-Redstone 4, July 21, 1961
records.summary_en: During the recovery of Liberty Bell 7 in the Atlantic Ocean, the rescue crew discussed a dye pack in the water that had not been activated. The recording does not explain what it was intended to do.

records.title: NASA-UAP-D015, Astronaut Scientific Debriefings, 1962-1963
records.summary_en: John Glenn and Walter Schirra reported luminous phenomena during spaceflights. NASA interviewed them, but the summary does not specify what they saw or what caused the lights.

records.title: NASA-UAP-D016, Preliminary Gemini 4 Crew Debriefing, Part I, 1965
records.summary_en: Ed White said he saw sparks during Gemini 4. The word appears in the official summary, but the available record neither describes what he saw nor explains what caused it.

records.title: NASA-UAP-D017, Preliminary Gemini 4 Crew Debriefing, Part II, 1965
records.summary_en: McDivitt couldn’t verify the accuracy of Gemini 4’s guidance instrument. On the third day, he compared its reading with what he saw outside the window, and the two matched.

records.title: NASA-UAP-D018, Gemini 4 Experiment Debriefing, 1967
records.summary_en: A NASA summary says two Gemini 4 astronauts reported bright particles outside their spacecraft. The transcript mentioned in the summary is not included in the material published here.

records.title: NASA-UAP-D019, Gemini 5 Technical Debriefing, Part I, 1965
records.summary_en: Gemini 5’s windows fogged up and froze before launch. Blowing hot air on them made matters worse, and a fly, a bee, and several spots remained visible inside the glass throughout the flight.

records.title: NASA-UAP-D020, Gemini 5 Technical Debriefing, Part II, 1965
records.summary_en: After the 1965 Gemini 5 mission, Gordon Cooper and Pete Conrad described debris, objects that looked like snow, and glittering fragments. The transcript doesn’t identify them.

records.title: NASA-UAP-D021, Gemini 7 Technical Debriefing, 1965
records.summary_en: After their spaceflight, Borman and Lovell talked about lights and flashes. They also said they couldn’t see the stars after the sun rose.

records.title: NASA-UAP-D022, Gemini 9 Debriefing, 1966
records.summary_en: A summary of a NASA debrief says Stafford and Cernan saw flashing lights and flashes during Gemini 9. The scan provided does not include a readable account of the sighting.

records.title: NASA-UAP-D023, Interview Excerpt with Astronaut Gordon Cooper, 1962
records.summary_en: Gordon Cooper told Walter Cronkite that many people, including some with exceptional training, had seen objects with no logical explanation. He also raised the possibility of life on other planets.

records.title: NASA-UAP-D024, “Apollo 16 Scientific Debriefing”
records.summary_en: A flash that had been seen but not yet reported came up during a NASA meeting about Apollo 16. It is unclear who saw it or what caused it.

records.title: NASA-UAP-D025, “Apollo 16 Scientific Debriefing”
records.summary_en: In a recording of an Apollo 16 science debrief, a speaker casually raised the possibility of an alien space base. The source does not say what the speaker was referring to or what prompted the remark.

records.title: ODNI-UAP-D001, USPER Narrative, Senior USIC Official
records.agency: Office of the Director of National Intelligence
records.summary_en: During a search in the mountains, a glowing object came very close to a helicopter, split apart, and vanished. Orange lights later appeared beside the helicopter and above fighter jets.

records.title: USG-UAP-D001, Congressional, White House, UFO-related Constituent Correspondence, 1998
records.summary_en: A man asked NASA for information about objects seen by astronauts. The agency said some were debris from launch vehicles or spacecraft, while others were water droplets. No unidentified objects were seen on lunar missions.

records.title: DOE-UAP-D004, Los Alamos Conference on Aerial Phenomena, 1949
records.summary_en: Lincoln LaPaz described a green fireball moving almost horizontally before breaking apart and vanishing in about two seconds. Scientists at Los Alamos disagreed about what caused it.

records.title: DOW-UAP-D094, Analysis of Flying Object Incidents in the United States, 1949
records.summary_en: Weather Service workers in Richmond saw metallic discs beside a balloon, months before newspapers began reporting flying saucers. An Air Force study examined about 210 reports but couldn’t identify the objects.

records.title: DOW-UAP-D097, Project Sign Progress Report, 1948
records.summary_en: In 1948, an air traffic controller near Columbus saw an object hovering and spinning. It moved to another spot and kept spinning. The Air Force investigated possible explanations but could not identify it with certainty.

records.title: DOW-UAP-PR104, Unresolved UAP Report, Yellow Sea, 2025
records.summary_en: Footage from a U.S. military sensor over the Yellow Sea shows an area that looks like a six-pointed star. The sensor tracks it, but the record does not identify it.

records.title: DOW-UAP-PR105, Unresolved UAP Report, East China Sea, 2025
records.summary_en: Footage from a military sensor shows an area that looks different from its surroundings slipping out of frame several times. The sensor later changes its zoom and direction, but nothing appears.

records.title: DOW-UAP-PR113, Unresolved UAP Report, Western United States, 1996
records.summary_en: A 1996 military video shows a blob crossing the screen, then replaying the movement in slow motion. The video was altered before it was submitted for examination, but it is not known who changed it or what it shows.

records.title: DOW-UAP-PR115, Unresolved UAP Report, Gulf of America, 2019
records.summary_en: In an eight-second video, a military sensor closes in on an area that looks different from its surroundings and tracks it. The area appears to flicker, then disappears from view.

records.title: NASA-UAP-D030, STS-80 Unidentified Object Image 1, 1996
records.summary_en: Astronauts aboard the space shuttle Columbia photographed an unidentified object three times. In the first image, it appears near Earth’s limb.

records.title: NASA-UAP-D031, STS-80 Unidentified Object Image 2, 1996
records.summary_en: In 1996, astronauts aboard the space shuttle Columbia photographed an object in space. It appears to be spinning in the second image, but NASA did not identify it.

records.title: NASA-UAP-D032, STS-80 Unidentified Object Image 3, 1996
records.summary_en: Astronauts aboard the space shuttle Columbia took three photographs in a series. An object appears against Earth in the third image. NASA describes it as seeming to have passed between the shuttle and the planet. Its identity is unknown.

records.title: CIA-UAP-D020, Memorandum on Unconventional Aircraft Sightings, 1955
records.summary_en: Four passengers, including Sen. Richard Russell, saw a yellow-green light climb into the sky from a train. A review suggested it could have been an aircraft or missile, but did not identify it.

records.title: CIA-UAP-D021, Analysis of Unconventional Aircraft Sightings, 1955
records.summary_en: Two lights rose into the sky and passed over a group of onlookers in 1955. A CIA document also described a pilot’s remark, but concluded that the account did not prove an unusual aircraft was involved.

records.title: DOE-UAP-D005, Pantex Unidentified Object Incident Report, 2015
records.summary_en: A surveillance system near the Pantex Plant detected a silent object flying north. Guards tried to catch up but lost it when the road ended.

records.title: DOW-UAP-D089, Range Fouler Debrief, Eastern United States, 2020
records.summary_en: A military operator in the eastern United States reported seeing a small object traveling in a steady direction in 2020. The operator described a reflective underside but could not make out its shape.

records.title: DOW-UAP-D090, Range Fouler Debrief, Eastern United States, 2019
